sources.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance ...
sources.snippet: The central estimator is DRB, or Document-Reasoning Balancer, a roughly 1B-parameter multimodal model built from SigLIP-2, Qwen3-0.6B, a cross-page fusion transformer, and an MLP head. It predicts performance before the target LLM runs, conditioning on the document, prompt, model identity, and requested budget.
